scope: Camera-local visual predicates only; no contact, attachment, release,3D placement or physical task completion
parameter_basis: Explicit engineering image tolerances fixed before real event replay; durations reuse previous prototype policy. Not calibrated probabilities, not fitted to SO101 AI intervals. Independent position error bounds are added, never replaced by these thresholds.
unknown_error_policy: Abstain; FB/NCC/reprojection residuals are not absolute localization error radii
identity_policy: Same reviewed semantic anchor and segment throughout interval; no cross-seed or occlusion bridging
camera_policy: Unknown camera motion permits image-relative observations only, never world/background-relative conclusions
tray_policy: Require independently reviewed whole-object projected enclosure and convex tray interior with explicit image error bounds. A feature hull or object anchor cannot establish full projected containment.
reference_policy: Frozen AI reviews may be read only after predictions are frozen; provisional development agreement only
